relevance_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
relevance_decisions.reason: Only tests change. The established exported API and contracts remain unchanged.

relevance_decisions.name: go-core-style
relevance_decisions.reason: Writing Go tests requires idiomatic test code, formatting, explicit errors, and version-aware constructs.

relevance_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
relevance_decisions.reason: No interfaces, concrete dependencies, constructors, options, production wiring, or production lifecycle decisions change.

relevance_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
relevance_decisions.reason: No packages, responsibilities, import ownership, or production import direction change.

relevance_decisions.name: go-test-isolation
relevance_decisions.reason: The task uses real files, independent roots, parallel subtests, grouped descendants, and fixture lifetime. The reference covers parent cleanup, joining parallel children, and focused selection.
